comments.author: @TravelHorizon-4K
comments.text: Hearing about 16.1 million bourbon barrels aging [00:15] while exports are down 26% [28:42] and production pauses [29:08]—on top of coal jobs dropping from over 19,000 to under 3,400 [00:30]—shows the risk of relying heavily on specific industries. What do you think—should rural Kentucky focus on attracting big manufacturing/logistics or building smaller local enterprises and nature tourism?

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: What I love about Kentucky is how much history and character seem woven into everyday life, from bluegrass music and horse country to the Appalachian communities. These places deserve more recognition. America's heartland has stories worth listening to, not overlooking.
